subject: Nimble MCEM with missing values in response variable

messages.author: 3a37dd5bbc4f63fd
messages.subject: Nimble MCEM with missing values in response variable
parts:
Hi All,

I'm trying to estimate model parameters of a zero-inflated beta regression model using MCEM approach in Nimble. I have some missing values in my response variable.
Without missing values in the response variable, it's working but it takes a lot of time. When there are missing values I'm getting the following error,

Error in optim(par = theta, fn = cCalc_E_llk$run, oldParamValues = thetaPrev,  : 
  non-finite finite-difference value [11] 

I'm not sure how to fix this issue. I really appreciate if anyone can help me regarding this.
(If you need to take look into my code I can provide it too)

Thank you

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Nimble MCEM with missing values in response variable
parts:
Hi Manushi,

Yes, we'd need to see your code.

Note that if you have missing values, the MCEM algorithm needs to
treat them as unknown parameters.
Presumably one wants to treat those missing values as latent variables
to integrate over (rather than maximizing over them).
Are you providing the missing values as part of 'latentNodes'?

Chris
